exposure: Type of caesarean section (planned vs. non-planned)
outcome: Likelihood of giving birth by caesarean section
cohort: Singleton births in Finland with publicly funded healthcare between 2000 and 2010
finding: Women with the lowest socioeconomic status were more likely to give birth by caesarean section, even after adjusting for various delivery characteristics.
mod_finding: This study found that women with lower socioeconomic status were more likely to give birth by cesarean section, both planned and non-planned, compared to women with higher socioeconomic status.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor but not specified
